fusions.name: Night Sip
fusions.desc: Sends a dart of darkness at the first enemy in a line up to 7 tiles away that deals 7 dark damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Thief of Life] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Shrieking Draught
fusions.desc: A shriek that deals 26 dark damage, ignoring resistances, to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt, and each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Roost and Digest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds, rising by 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Small-Hours Appetite
fusions.desc: At night you deal 12% more damage. You have 5% more dodge chance at all times.
